issue.title: bob props leaves reference sync/identity keys loose, so the generic Property Editor can corrupt Highlights sync state
issue.description:
On a reference note, `bob props` protects only `type` (identity) and `source_markdown`
(derived, "reference importer"). Every other key — `id`, `status`, `parent`,
`ref_type`, `source_pdf`, `source_pdf_sha256`, all `highlights_*` sync-bookkeeping
keys (`highlights_marker_hash`, `highlights_marker_base`, `highlights_sidecar`,
`highlights_count`, `highlights_synced_at`, …), `pipeline_version`, `audio`,
`earlier`, `recaptured`, and zorg provenance — is classified `role: "loose",
owner: "props"`, so the generic `+` Property Editor offers them as freely editable.

A hand edit to any of these corrupts state another writer owns: a changed
`highlights_marker_hash`/`_base` breaks the three-way PDF marker merge; `id` must
follow the file stem (`decisions:reference-ids-follow-file-stems`; `bob ref rename`
owns renames); a v2 `parent` is projected from the reading task's residence and
`status` is reconciled with the `#task #ref` checkbox, so direct edits either get
silently re-projected or create sync conflicts.

Remediation sketch (detailed role table in the linked research report, § "The bob-cli
phase"): tighten `derived_role`/classification for notes under bob's ref coverage
(`ref/**`) so pipeline/sync keys become derived with owners and teaching reasons, and
`id`/`ref_type` become identity. Scope by ref coverage, not by `type: [[ref]]` alone:
13 root-level `*_ref.md` hub notes carry that type but are not references and must
stay loose. The same policy must bind set, unset, rename, YAML replacement, and undo
paths, with the raw-YAML escape kept as the deliberate recovery route. If formerly
accepted generic writes now refuse, the commit is a contract break and needs `!`
(`decisions:bob-cli-releases-ride-a-daily-train`).

Corroborated independently by all five research.6l swarm researchers and verified by
the lead at bob-cli 8025ab3c. The planned ref-cards epic would fix this in its
`ref-props` phase; this bead tracks the integrity gap in case that epic is not
approved, since the footgun exists with or without the card.

task_type_fields.impact: Generic + Property Editor edits on any of 1,377 reference notes can break the three-way PDF marker merge, desync id from the file stem, or fight the reading-task projection of parent/status
task_type_fields.repro: bob props show ref/blogs/the_ai_native_sdlc_playbook.md -f json — observe id, status, parent, ref_type, source_pdf_sha256, highlights_marker_hash, pipeline_version all report role "loose", owner "props"; grep Reference src/native/props/roles.rs shows reference-specific protection covers only source_markdown

issue.creation_reason: Found while consolidating the ref-cards research swarm: the gap is a live data-integrity footgun on 1,377 reference notes whether or not ref cards ship, and no existing bead or in-progress epic covers it.

payload.entry: Fixed by bob-cli-qp.1 (bob-cli 0846b038 feat(props): add Reference contract and roles), closed at the bob-cli-qp landing. src/native/props/roles.rs now scopes NoteKind::Reference to type [[ref]] notes inside ref_library::is_library_member_path coverage, so root *_ref hubs, ref_history/, and .assets stay ordinary notes. For covered references, id and ref_type are identity (teaching bob ref rename); highlights_*, source_pdf, source_pdf_sha256, and pipeline_version are derived and owned by Highlights sync; audio, return_links, earlier, recaptured, and source_markdown by the importer or reread lineage; Zorg provenance by migrate-zorg; meeting fields by bob ref meet; status and parent are derived only when a managed embed or a ^ref tracker is present. Refusals bind set, unset, rename, set_yaml, and restore (docs/props.md). Verified on bob-cli master 85d2fb32: RUST_TEST_THREADS=8 cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast reported 13344 passed, 0 failed (includes the props role, refusal, and contract suites). bob-cli-qp.7's real-Obsidian acceptance confirmed the protected-key refusals end to end (54/54, file:explicit:71e7c7a55117ffd98b5fec4b). The commit lacked the ! marker the plan required; the bob-cli-qp lander adds a docs(props)! migration note so the next changelog lists the break.

payload.description: Confirm the protected-keys bug the ref-props phase was to resolve is closed
